Name: Johanan, Captain of Gad
Summary: Eighth captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:12: Eighth captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
LifeLesson: The mention of Johanan in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
